summary_en: Last One Mile authorized repurchase of up to 54,000 shares (2.01% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥2.0 billion via open market purchases between November 2, 2026 and February 28, 2027 to enhance capital efficiency and return value to shareholders.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Last One Mile's Board of Directors approved on October 30, 2026 the acquisition of treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company authorized repurchase of up to 54,000 shares at a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥200 million, representing 2.01% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The repurchase will be conducted via open market purchases (tateba) between November 2, 2026 and February 28, 2027.

The stated purpose is to execute flexible capital policies in response to changing business conditions and enhance capital efficiency while returning profits to shareholders. As of October 29, 2026, the company held 127,972 treasury shares against 2,682,810 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
